items.quote:
laid siege to Samaria.
25  There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver
items.contrast: The army was already besieging Samaria, not still mobilizing for the march.
items.reason: The high price resulted during the prolonged siege, and the preceding sentence identifies Ben-Hadad’s army as the force that laid siege to Samaria. The question clearly tests the timing of the army’s action.
